The Reserve Bank of India was established on
RBI was established on 1 April 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India is located in
RBI's central office is in Mumbai.
Which of the following is NOT a function of RBI?
Regulation of stock markets is SEBI's function, not RBI's.
The RBI's monetary policy is formulated by
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is responsible for fixing the benchmark policy interest rate (repo rate).
The current repo rate is decided by
The MPC, consisting of 6 members, decides the repo rate.
Which section of the RBI Act deals with the Monetary Policy Committee?
Section 45ZA of the RBI Act, 1934 deals with the Monetary Policy Committee.
Which of the following is the RBI's department responsible for currency management?
The Department of Currency Management (DCM) handles currency management.
The RBI's 'Financial Stability Report' is published
The Financial Stability Report is published half-yearly by RBI.
Which of the following is NOT a subsidiary of RBI?
C) Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran
SEBI is an independent statutory body, not a subsidiary of RBI.
Utkarsh 2.0 is RBI's medium-term strategy framework for 2023-2025.
Which committee recommended the establishment of RBI?
The Hilton Young Commission (1926) recommended the establishment of RBI.
The RBI's 'Prompt Corrective Action' (PCA) framework applies to
B) Banks with weak financial metrics
PCA framework is applied to banks that breach certain thresholds of capital adequacy, asset quality, and profitability.
Which of the following is the RBI's payment system for large-value transactions?
RTGS (Real Time Gross Settlement) is used for large-value transactions.
The minimum capital requirement for a new bank license in India is
RBI requires minimum capital of ₹500 crore for new bank licenses.
B) Access, usage and quality of financial services
The Financial Inclusion Index measures access, usage and quality of financial services.
Which of the following is NOT regulated by RBI?
Insurance companies are regulated by IRDAI, not RBI.
B) A digital form of sovereign currency
CBDC (Central Bank Digital Currency) is a digital form of the Indian Rupee issued by RBI.
Which of the following is the RBI's department for banking supervision?
D) Department of Payment and Settlement Systems
E) Department of Economic and Policy Research
The Department of Banking Supervision (DBS) oversees banking supervision.
The RBI's 'Master Direction on KYC' was last updated in
RBI's KYC Master Direction was significantly updated in 2022.
Which of the following is the RBI's credit information company?
CIBIL (Credit Information Bureau (India) Limited) is the primary credit information company.
LAF includes repo rate (RBI lends to banks) and reverse repo rate (RBI borrows from banks).
Which of the following is the RBI's department for economic research?
A) Department of Economic and Policy Research
B) Department of Statistics and Information Management
Both DEPR and DSIM handle economic research and statistics.
The RBI's 'Financial Markets Regulation Department' (FMRD) oversees
B) Money, forex and government securities markets
FMRD regulates money, foreign exchange and government securities markets.
Which of the following is the RBI's initiative for financial literacy?
RBI observes Financial Literacy Week annually.
The Regulatory Sandbox allows fintech companies to test innovative products in a controlled environment.
